title: pilosella glomerata subsp. bialkana
intro: Pilosella glomerata subsp. bialkana, commonly known as Alpine Buttercup, is a rare and endemic plant species found in the mountainous regions of Bulgaria. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Pilosella glomerata subsp. bialkana include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as reducing inflammation and improving immune function. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
